events.label: Summit
events.title: 1st Muchinga Youth Summit
events.description: Organized and attended the landmark 1st Muchinga Youth Summit, bringing together young people from across the province to foster leadership, skills development, and civic engagement. Graced by the Provincial Youth Coordinator as the chief guest, the event served as a collaborative platform for youth empowerment and was successfully executed through generous corporate sponsorship from National Savings and Credit Bank (NATSAVE) and Indo-Zambian Bank.

events.label: Cultural Festival
events.title: Muchinga Cultural Festival
events.description: invited to speak at the Muchinga Cultural Festival alongside the District Commissioners of Nakonde and Mpika, where I delivered an address inspiring young people to embrace their rich cultural heritage as a fundamental pillar of African identity.
